step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify all 11 architecture components from the whiteboard visual inventory and audio transcript: Customer Lambda (client's monitored Lambda), Kinesis 1 (ingests log data), Transform Lambda (analyzes logs), DynamoDB (stores metadata/partial state), Kinesis 2 (stream of invocation records), Storage Lambda (processes fast query path), Aurora (serverless database), Firehose (batching/delivery), Glue (schema definition/conversion), S3 Bucket (data lake), and Athena (analytics engine).
2. Normalize services against the vocabulary list: Lambda, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Aurora, Firehose, Glue, S3, Athena.
3. Segment into logical flows:
   - Flow 0: Log ingestion and invocation record transformation (Customer Lambda -> Kinesis 1 -> Transform Lambda <-> DynamoDB -> Kinesis 2).
   - Flow 1: Fast querying path (Kinesis 2 -> Storage Lambda -> Aurora).
   - Flow 2: Analytics and aggregated metric data lake path (Kinesis 2 -> Firehose, Glue -> Firehose -> S3 Bucket <- Athena).

graph.name: Epsagon Lambda Metrics Monitoring Architecture
graph.notes: Epsagon architecture for generating metrics and aggregated analytics on customer Lambda executions using CloudWatch logs streaming through Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB, Serverless Aurora, Kinesis Firehose, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, and Amazon Athena.

nodes.name: Customer Lambda
nodes.notes: Client's Lambda function being monitored for memory, timeouts, and errors.

nodes.name: Kinesis 1
nodes.notes: Receives filtered CloudWatch logs from the customer account.

nodes.name: Transform Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes raw log streams into structured invocation records.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores customer function configurations and tracks partial execution states.

nodes.name: Kinesis 2
nodes.notes: Central stream holding transformed invocation records.

nodes.name: Storage Lambda
nodes.notes: Buffers writes to Aurora and manages connection concurrency.

nodes.name: Aurora
nodes.notes: Serverless Aurora database used for fast, single-item request ID queries.

nodes.name: Firehose
nodes.notes: Batches records and converts JSON to Parquet format.

nodes.name: Glue
nodes.notes: Provides table schema for Firehose data conversion.

nodes.name: S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Data lake storing Parquet invocation records.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Performs ad-hoc SQL queries on S3 for aggregated operational metrics.
